## How I tested it

- [ ] `bash scripts/gerbang-ujian.sh`
- [ ] If this changes a rule: positive and negative fixtures in `fixtures/rules/<id>/`, and a test that fails without this change
- [ ] If this touches the playground: checked in English and Bahasa Melayu, on a narrow phone screen
- [ ] If this touches the contract: a Foundry test that fails without this change
- [ ] If this is a design decision: a record in `docs/decisions/`
